parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.
> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number when you use paged query. Default value: **1**, which indicates that the first page is returned in the paging result.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page when you use paged query. Default value: 10, which indicates that each page contains 10 entries in the paging result.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: SensitiveCode
parameters.description:
The type of sensitive data.
> You can call [DescribeApisecRules](~~2859155~~) to obtain the supported sensitive data types.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.
